title: agent-usage settings
description: Your changes over mods/agent-usage/services.json and the widget's scan defaults. Written by the usage settings screen (ctrl-shift-u) and the card's hide switch; holds only what differs from the defaults.

everyMinutes.description: How often the strip re-reads session logs.

limitsEveryMinutes.description: How often plan limits are fetched (Claude, OpenCode Go; rate-limited server-side).

services.description: Per-service switches, keyed by the service's key in services.json.

enabled.description: false: don't scan it at all.

hidden.description: true: keep scanning, but leave it out of the strip, card and rail.
